map.Basic Auth 把\"用户名:密码\"Base64 后放入请求头。本工具生: Basic Auth Base64-encodes "username:password" and puts it in the request header. This tool builds the standard header value and a copyable curl command to ease integration testing. Credentials are generated locally and never uploaded.
map.Basic Auth 明文传输，务必配 HTTPS: Basic Auth transmits in plaintext, so always pair it with HTTPS
map.→ 去使用 Basic Auth 生成器（免费 · 纯前端 · 数据不上传）: -> Go use the Basic Auth generator (free, fully front-end, nothing uploaded)
map.仅编码非加密，配合 HTTPS 才安全。: It is encoding, not encryption, and is only safe together with HTTPS.
map.凭据勿硬编码进前端: Never hard-code credentials into the frontend
map.复制 curl 或请求头: Copy the curl command or the header
